review_scope: GDT1118 MODEL and preregistration; EK decision dossier; GDT931, GDT932, GDT933, and GDT1117 reports; admitted GDT1117 native source paragraphs at f77r, f104r, and f115v
independence_limit: This is a scoped critique of already exposed project materials, not an independent review, blind test, or evidence for any word meaning.

findings.issue: f77r.27 depends on a referent identity beyond the lexical tuple
findings.detail: The N rendering treats OKAIIN SHEDY as one material/preparation entity, then identifies that entity as the carrier of QOKEEDY. The model explicitly assumes this compound and shared copula/flow subject. That is coherent as a candidate construction, but no independent structural result currently establishes that adjacency composes the two forms this way or that the post-copular phrase and later subject have identical reference. The German 'same preparation' makes this extra commitment visible; it is not supplied by an extra written item.

findings.issue: The f77r.14 extension does not independently establish the f77r.27 compound
findings.detail: N reads QOTEEDY QOKAIIN SHEDY as a portion/of-liquid/preparation sequence and assumes appositional scope so the portion and preparation are one entity. This adds both a part-to-whole relation and the same-entity link. It can be made compatible with the proposed material-preparation phrase, but the shared identity is a semantic assumption, not a consequence of the shared final groups or a confirmation of OKAIIN/SHEDY meanings. Keep the f77r.14 extension conditional on that scope and identity.

findings.issue: The two OKAIIN constructions carry an unpaid contrast
findings.detail: N assigns bare OKAIIN='liquid' in OKAIIN SHEDY, but QOKAIIN='of-liquid' in QOKAIIN SHEDY, using the latter as a genitive. This is an explicit, narrow whole-form contrast inherited from GDT932V, not a demonstrated Q-meaning or a general genitive rule. The joint account remains compatible only if the construction-level difference is retained as a hypothesis; it cannot be cited as evidence that the compound or genitive analysis is structurally established.

findings.issue: Scope limits and prior failures appear preserved
findings.detail: The 1118 model keeps the 1117 EFF meanings and states the M/V whole-form overrides; its N tuple does not repair the f104r.43 immediate-patient counterexample. The admitted f104r paragraph still gives no identified carrier for QOKEEDY, so leaving that relation unbound is appropriate. Likewise, the 115v extension is dictionary coverage with 12 groups unread and surrounding identities unbound, not a completed reading. These ceilings should remain attached to any summary of N.

conclusion: N is internally expressible as the declared exploratory tuple, with no detected repair to the registered 1117 failure. Its strongest semantic burden is the compound/genitive construction plus the same-entity links at f77r.27 and f77r.14. These are disclosed assumptions, not support for selecting or confirming the candidate. No new gloss, construction rule, or result is proposed here.
